name: Gemini 435Le
summary: Gemini 435Le is an industrial stereo depth camera for long-range mobile-robot perception and logistics measurement. Gigabit Ethernet with PoE, an IP67 enclosure and scene-specific presets support navigation, obstacle detection and object dimensioning. It integrates with Orbbec SDK v2, ROS and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

sources.title: Gemini 435Le: Long-Range Ethernet Camera for Warehouses
sources.quote: The Gemini 435Le features industrial-standard interfaces: an M12 X-coded connector for Gigabit Ethernet with Power over Ethernet (PoE, IEEE 802.3af), and an M12 A-coded connector for DC power input, sync-in/out, and RS485 communication. It supports multi-camera hardware sync via M8 A-coded connector—enabling precise multi-device collaboration for complex robotic systems.

specs.formatted: Gigabit Ethernet with PoE, IEEE 802.3af, M12 X-coded

sources.title: Gemini 435Le: Long-Range Ethernet Camera for Warehouses
sources.quote: The Gemini 435Le offers a depth range of 0.20m to 20+ meters, with reliable depth performance within 6 meters for all applications. It delivers depth accuracy of ±1% at 2m, spatial precision of ≤0.8% at 2m and ≤1.6% at 4m, with resolutions up to 1280x800 at 10fps or 640x400 at 20fps. The 90°×65° field of view provides wide coverage for navigation and perception tasks.

sources.title: Automate 2025: Gemini 435Le Long-Range Camera
sources.quote: DETROIT, May 12, 2025 — At the largest robotics and automation show in the Americas, Automate 2025, Orbbec today unveiled its Gemini 435Le , the latest addition to its industrial-grade stereo vision lineup, delivering substantial enhancements for industrial applications and offering industry-leading depth sensing performance.

sources.title: Gemini 435Le: Long-Range Ethernet Camera for Warehouses
sources.quote: The Gemini 435Le is supported by the open-source Orbbec SDK V2.0, which works across multiple operating systems and programming languages. It provides native support for ROS1, ROS2, and NVIDIA Isaac ROS frameworks, and comes pre-integrated with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, Orin NX, and Orin Nano platforms. Online firmware upgrade functionality and professional technical support are also available to accelerate deployment.
